The Geek Veterinarian - Bhakti, Gyaan, Karma is a venture to dream, explore and implement in Veterinary and related fields.
Here, you are welcomed to know about Veterinary and more with The Geek Vet in the easiest ways possible. Read the blogs, listen to the podcast, or opinionate about science, human-animal-nature relationship, and more.
This Youtube channel is another extension of TGV, where I will share my experience, book reviews, and more numerous things with you a chance to empower the veterinary field on this very platform of Youtube. 
 Find the links to the official accounts and pursuits by the Geek Vet at your fingertips.
